title.from: Demonstrate a DSPy bridge that performs automated optimization

description.from:
## Scope

After native optimization works, assess an optional DSPy integration against its actual optimizer execution contract. Preserve typed decisions and development-only tuning; do not ship a wrapper whose only capability is model inference.

## Definition of done

A fake decision model runs an end-to-end automated DSPy optimization and reproduces the saved result, or a documented incompatibility closes the investigation without advertising unsupported optimization.
description.to:
## WITHDRAWN

This assistant-authored task was unauthorized: the user explicitly excluded DSPy from this project. Preserve this closed record and its history; do not revive or implement DSPy integration.

Native, provider-neutral Decision Flywheel optimization remains the applicable scope.
